Hi Elena — thanks for sending these over and for the clear ask. Looping in Marissa from Procurement to get this into our vendor setup pipeline.

Short answers up front:
- Redwood standard for new vendors is Net 45 (we can do Net 30 for strategic partners).
- We do run early-pay discounts in a limited pilot (Finance approval required) — typical band is 1.0–1.75% for 7–15 day pay terms.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa to confirm required vendor docs and route to AP (I've attached our internal onboarding checklist).
2) If BrightBridge would prefer Net 30, Marissa will raise a request and include a proposed early-pay discount.
3) If approved, Procurement will create a PO template and we can share the DocuSign URL to sign master vendor terms.

Can you confirm BrightBridge's preferred default (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60) and whether you'd like to opt into an early-pay discount at the ~1.5% level (we'll validate with Finance)?

Thanks — Mateo

Marissa / Mateo — quick finance POV:
- We can make Net 30 available for strategic pilots but prefer Net 45 as default for new suppliers to manage cashflow. Approvals: Manager-level approval sufficient for Net 30 if expected monthly spend < $100k; otherwise needs FP&A sign-off.
- Early-pay: for pilot partners we can approve up to 1.5% discount for payments within 15 days. Finance will require a pilot term (90 days) and a monthly cap on discount liability (set here at $2,000/month based on forecast).
- Language: include phrase "1.5% early-pay discount if invoice paid within 15 calendar days; otherwise Net 45 applies." Add a cap clause for cumulative discounts.

Action items for Procurement: please set PO payment terms to Net 45 by default and add an addendum option for the early-pay pilot. Once vendor signs, AP will set up the payment lane.

Kimberly Park
